Revision 5 remains unapprovable. The group capture_complete_observation sends complete raw pages into assemble_full_snapshot/assemble_narrow_snapshot/choose_complete_snapshot interpretation and trusts model-authored complete booleans; this recreates the oversized-request failure and lets an LLM assert technical completeness. The unconditional narrow read also uses an unobserved main selector even when the full capture is complete.
Make a focused structural correction, preserving accepted requirements, the query input, actual per-product visits, real write_workbook operation, produced-file output binding and unconditional cleanup. Remove the technical interpretation/assembly/selection tasks in that group. Read an observation_pages manifest, require its authoritative capture/manifest truncation flags to be false using existing predicates, and consume every listed page in a bounded foreach before navigation. Keep completeness guards tied directly to producer metadata. Explicitly stop when capture requires narrowing; do not perform a guessed selector read. Do not reject a non-final page merely for having nextCursor when its manifest lists all pages that are actually consumed.
Use existing typed value/field/object bindings and copy-only foreach for page record projections; keep nested arrays in declared exports, without flattening via a model. Pass separate consumer views: consent decision needs observed text/kind and control identity; product selection needs observed text/kind/href and necessary grouping; observed-field extraction needs text/semantic fields and source URL. Do not pass selectors/long unused references to decisions that do not need them. Keep all original pages covered and retain exact references for later actions. Use existing extract/each only when structuring untyped item values is necessary, one result per item; global product selection/ranking is interpret on the compact view, not implicit filtering in independent extraction. Do not return invented status labels from extract: observed nullable fields come from extraction; any status synthesis belongs to the explicit final interpretation or existing deterministic business conditions.
Preserve the ten-product bound, permissions, provider ceilings, output path and all oracles. Do not add a planner rule, change runtime semantics or replace writing with a literal. Keep the resulting TaskPlan concise.
